name: constant-without-expected-type-test-645773bda1/constant_without_expected_type-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.int lists Signed8, Signed16, Signed32, Unsigned8, Unsigned16, Unsigned32, toHexString, fromString and fromHexString, but not MAX_VALUE.
Operators: multiplicative, bitwise, additive and shift operators; unary logical, numeric and bitwise complement operators are listed as supported.
Subset restrictions > Other invocation restrictions: "value:toString and value:toBalString" are supported in method call syntax.
reason: The whole case requires int:MAX_VALUE in const CUI5 = -int:MAX_VALUE and asserts its negated value. MAX_VALUE is absent from the restricted ballerina/lang.int API list, making this an essential unsupported dependency despite constant declarations and the arithmetic operators being supported.
test_design_notes: main invokes all test functions, including the assertion for CUI5. No @args, @panic or @output directives occur. The assertions also exercise constant arithmetic, IEEE NaN/infinity and remainder results, bit shifts, mapping access and supported value:toString calls.
